notes: Acquired subset; no claim of a complete professional census or true all-history record.
2012–2021 series IDs unavailable: map encounters are not distinct series.
Reconstructed Elo ranks describe the acquired population, not published HLTV ranks.
50 maps within 365 days; calendar windows require 10 observed maps. Opponent/day ordering and scoreboard participation assumptions apply.
PPI is experimental, not round-winning contribution. Role, economy and team-resource confounding remain.
Team changes mark first observed roster appearances, not verified signing dates.
Static snapshot search covers top 100 per metric; complete windows/population remain in local database.

Both-eras display compares separately calculated game cohorts; no mixed-game windows. Equal rates do not establish equal skill across game versions. Unresolved cross-source identities remain separate.

media.note: Licensed identity portraits and organization marks. Images/marks are not asserted to be contemporaneous with each historical match. Trademark rights remain with owners; no endorsement implied.
